$commentaire: 28 octobre 2026 : sons de JEU (récompense), pas de bruitage réaliste. Principe demandé par Malik : un swoosh doux pour tout le défilement, un vrai son seulement quand la carte le mérite (rare, épique, légendaire, parfait). Trois variantes par son, à choisir à l'écoute.

sons.label: Swoosh doux (déchirure, extraction, retournement)
sons.prompt: Soft smooth airy whoosh swipe sound effect for a mobile game user interface, one quick gentle sweep from low to high, clean and pleasant, rounded like a cartoon game transition. No hiss, no crackle, no noise burst, no paper or plastic texture, no voice, no music.

sons.label: Récompense carte rare
sons.prompt: Mobile card game reward sound effect: a single bright pleasant glassy bell ding with one tiny quick sparkle on top, warm and satisfying, clean natural fade-out to silence with no ringing whistle at the end. Game user interface style, not realistic foley, no voice.

sons.label: Récompense carte épique
sons.prompt: Mobile card game reward sound effect for an epic card: a rising three-note magical chime on celesta and harp with a soft shimmering sparkle sweep, bright, warm and satisfying, short natural decay that ends cleanly in silence, no high-pitched whistle, game user interface style, not realistic foley.

sons.label: Récompense carte légendaire
sons.prompt: Mobile card game reward sound effect for a legendary card: a rich ascending magical harp and bell flourish landing on a warm shimmering chord with a soft sparkle cascade and a gentle low whoosh underneath, triumphant but gentle, mobile gacha reveal feeling, smooth decay to silence, no harsh or piercing high frequencies.

sons.label: Récompense booster parfait
sons.prompt: Mobile card game celebration reward sound for a perfect booster pack: a sparkling bell cascade rising up then a warm full major chord with a soft airy pad and a twinkling bell tail, joyful and very satisfying, smooth ending to silence, no harsh or piercing high frequencies, game user interface style, not realistic foley.
